name: Kimberly Harrison-Donaldson
tagline: Top rated Immigration attorney in Columbus, Ohio
education: The Ohio State University Michael E. Moritz College of Law
about: Kimberly Harrison-Donaldson, the visionary behind Harrison - Donaldson, Attorney at Law, in Columbus, Ohio, has carved out a remarkable reputation for her unwavering dedication and proficiency in the legal field. Known for her meticulous approach, she handles every aspect of her cases, from groundwork to paperwork, with precision and care. Her practice primarily focuses on business immigration, including H-1B and H-2B visas, while also offering services in family immigration within Columbus.

Ms. Harrison-Donaldson's impressive academic background includes a Juris Doctor from The Ohio State University’s Moritz College of Law and an MBA with a major in finance and a minor in real estate finance from The OSU’s Fisher College of Business. Her undergraduate journey at Valparaiso University saw her graduate cum laude with a Bachelor of Science in business management, complemented by minors in international business, global studies and theology.

Throughout her career, Ms. Harrison-Donaldson has successfully assisted countless individuals in securing employment-based and family-based visas, green cards, and citizenship. Her representation extends to appearances before the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services, the U.S. Department of Labor, the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, and the Board of Immigration Appeals.

Ms. Harrison-Donaldson’s adept handling of diverse cases and clients has earned her a stellar reputation as a highly competent and personable attorney within the legal community. Recognized as an authority on immigration law, she has been quoted in The Daily Reporter and other publications, and frequently shares her insights at immigration law seminars, round tables and Q&A sessions.

A respected figure in the legal arena, Ms. Harrison-Donaldson actively participates in several professional organizations, including the Ohio State Bar Association, the Columbus Bar Association, the Cleveland Metropolitan Bar Association, the American Immigration Lawyers Association and the American Bar Association.
